papers.title_en: AiSAQ-in-Filtering for DRAM-free Filtered Information Retrieval
papers.authors: Kento Tatsuno, Daisuke Miyashita, Kazunari Sumiyoshi, Hiroaki Yamanaka, Kosuke Nakata, Jun Deguchi
papers.evidence: 面向过滤式近似最近邻检索的标签内蕴乘积量化
papers.tldr: 过滤式近似最近邻搜索需同时存储向量与标签，数据规模增大后DRAM占用成为关键瓶颈。本文提出AiSAQ-in-Filtering及LiPQ量化方法，将无结构向量与结构化标签融合为单一表示，不增加编码数据量。在单标签搜索中recall@1最高提升55%，磁盘I/O更少，并保留AiSAQ将DRAM占用最多降至1/78、缩短索引切换时间的优势。该方案还可扩展到稀疏-稠密混合检索等场景。
papers.abstract_en: Filtering search is one of the crucial applications of approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS). In filtering search, label information is used in conjunction with unstructured vector data. ANNS provides efficient similarity search in large-scale datasets, however, the memory footprint of storing both vector data and their associated label becomes a significant cost factor as dataset sizes grow. To address this problem of increasing DRAM usage, we propose AiSAQ-in-Filtering, with a novel quantization method called LiPQ (Label-inclusive Product Quantization). LiPQ combines unstructured data and structured labels into a single representation, leading no growth of encoded data. Our proposal increased recall@1 of single-label searches by up to 55% and fewer disk I/Os compared with existing methods. This also retains the main advantages of AiSAQ, which can reduce DRAM footprint by up to 1/78 and index switching time comparing with existing methods. This proposal can also be applied to sparse-dense hybrid search beyond label filtering such as semantic and keyword search of documents.

papers.title_en: ConStore: Search-Overlapped Prefetch and Co-Retrieval-Aware Content Storage for Disk-Based ANNS
papers.authors: Zhutao Zhuang, Nong Xiao, Zhiguang Chen, Yue Yu
papers.evidence: 面向向量检索的磁盘式近似最近邻搜索
papers.tldr: 大K磁盘ANNS中，内容获取延迟可与向量搜索相当，现有研究多聚焦小top-K向量搜索。ConStore用SICP预取，结合RPAG共检索分组、WASR自适应重组和GCF批量页感知读取，降低内容获取开销且不改最终top-K。多跳QA负载K=10–1600，端到端延迟较逐文档基线最多降48%（DiskANN）和25%（SPANN），100M至十亿向量索引验证SICP可扩展。该工作把内容存储纳入端到端优化，为大规模ANNS提供预取与布局协同。
papers.abstract_en: Disk-based approximate nearest-neighbor search (ANNS) supports retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), search, recommendation, and advertising over corpora that exceed memory capacity. Existing ANNS research often focuses on vector search at small top-K, whereas industrial-scale applications require larger retrieval sets. Fetching the corresponding content from storage remains comparatively underexplored. Our profiling across million- to billion-vector corpora shows that, at large K, content fetch latency can match or exceed vector-search latency and cannot be ignored in end-to-end retrieval.   We present ConStore, a content storage engine combining two complementary techniques to reduce end-to-end retrieval latency. Speculative Inline Content Prefetch (SICP) commonly abstracts graph-based and cluster-based ANNS as progressive SSD I/O that refines an in-flight candidate queue. It prefetches content for stable leading candidates under a bounded I/O budget, overlapping content reads with search without changing the final top-K results. Co-Retrieval-Pattern-Aware Grouping (RPAG) uses query logs to place frequently co-retrieved documents in contiguous segments. Workload-Adaptive Segment Reorganization (WASR) adapts this layout to workload shifts by selectively regrouping segments under a bounded rewrite budget. Group Content Fetch (GCF) exploits this layout to coalesce per-document random reads into batched, page-aware I/O requests. SICP works independently of the content layout, while RPAG and GCF reduce fetch cost even without prefetching.   Across three multi-hop QA workloads with K from 10 to 1600, ConStore reduces end-to-end retrieval latency over the best per-document-read baseline by up to 48% on DiskANN and 25% on SPANN. Separate experiments on 100M- and billion-vector indexes demonstrate SICP's applicability at larger scales.

papers.title_en: PrairieFire: Igniting High-Throughput Updates in Large-Scale Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
papers.authors: Yuchen Huang, Baiteng Ma, Yiping Sun, Xiao Chen, Rui Ma, Yue Chen, Jinwei Zhang, Xiaocheng Zhong, Zhiyong Wang, Yao Hu, Erci Xu, Chuliang Weng
papers.evidence: 面向十亿级近似最近邻搜索的高吞吐更新
papers.tldr: SSD阵列带宽接近内存且成本更低，使十亿级向量的近似最近邻搜索更多运行在SSD系统上。但现有方案更新吞吐受限：前台插入频繁访问SSD，后台重分配反复搬移向量，索引难以跟上数据与模型变化。PrairieFire采用缓冲更新与批量局部重建，并结合级联调整、并发控制和CPU-GPU-SSD协同，减少前台SSD访问与后台重分配。评测显示更新吞吐提升约3-35倍、搜索吞吐约3-5倍、成本效率约1.5-8.7倍；系统已在RedNote生产部署两个月，以更高新鲜度改善业务指标且无需频繁重建索引。
papers.abstract_en: Arrays of modern NVMe SSDs are approaching memory in terms of bandwidth while offering much lower cost per gigabyte. Hence, approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) for billion-scale vectors in applications such as recommendation, search, and retrieval-augmented generation increasingly runs on SSD-based systems. Unfortunately, due to the limited update throughput of existing SSD-based solutions, the indexed corpus cannot keep pace with continuous modifications to data and embedding models, thus hindering broader deployment across more scenarios and larger scales.   The bottleneck lies in CPU-intensive update paths, where foreground insertions incur frequent SSD accesses and background reassignments repeatedly relocate each vector, making high update throughput difficult to achieve even by exhausting available hardware. In this paper, using buffered updates and batched local rebuilds, we develop PrairieFire with cascaded adjustments, concurrency control, and CPU-GPU-SSD cooperation. These co-designs avoid frequent SSD accesses in foreground updates and heavy background reassignments, achieving high update throughput while maintaining excellent search performance.   Evaluations show that, compared with state-of-the-art systems, PrairieFire can sustain approximately 3-35x update throughput while maintaining approximately 3-5x search throughput simultaneously. It also achieves approximately 1.5-8.7x cost efficiency. PrairieFire has been deployed in RedNote's production environments for two months, improving business metrics by higher freshness without frequent index rebuilds.

papers.title_en: RemoteANN: A Native Vector Search Engine for Cloud Object Storage
papers.authors: Yutong Gou, Silu Huang, Yue Wang, Jianjun Chen, Cheng Long
papers.evidence: 面向云对象存储的向量搜索引擎
papers.tldr: 云对象存储上的向量搜索常因高网络延迟和按请求计费导致I/O放大与吞吐下降。RemoteANN从索引与查询协同设计出发，将IVF与RaBitQ量化结合，并通过簇间/簇内重排、范围GET合并及NVMe缓存减少离散请求。在真实数据集上，它以97%召回实现最高5.9倍吞吐提升、对象存储请求减少16.1倍。该工作为云对象存储原生向量检索提供了低I/O、低成本方案。
papers.abstract_en: Vector search engines built on cloud object storage have drawn growing attention from both academia and industry. These systems typically adopt a disaggregated storage-compute architecture, persisting the primary vector payload in object stores (e.g., Amazon S3) while retaining compact index metadata on compute nodes. However, conventional vector indexing structures are not natively tailored to the pronounced network latency and per-request access costs of cloud object stores, resulting in network I/O amplification, degraded query throughput, and higher API expenses.   To resolve these challenges, we present RemoteANN, a vector search engine explicitly co-designed for cloud object storage across indexing and querying. To mitigate the dominant network I/O bottleneck, RemoteANN couples an Inverted File (IVF) index with RaBitQ quantization, further optimized by inter-cluster and intra-cluster data reordering for improved data locality. Building on this tailored data layout, RemoteANN's query engine combines cluster pruning, fine-grained Range-GET requests, request merging, and local NVMe SSD caching, dramatically reducing discrete storage requests and network transfer volume without sacrificing accuracy. To address the index construction bottleneck, we further develop QGKMeans, which substantially reduces construction latency without compromising clustering quality. Extensive evaluations on real-world datasets demonstrate that, compared with representative baselines, RemoteANN achieves up to a $5.9\times$ throughput speedup while issuing up to $16.1\times$ fewer object storage requests at 97% target recall.

papers.title_en: Amora: Communication-Efficient Private Approximate Nearest Neighbors Search
papers.authors: Qiuhao Wang, Zuowei Chen, Xu Yang, Saiyu Qi, Yong Qi
papers.evidence: 面向云端向量数据库的图索引隐私近似最近邻检索
papers.tldr: 云托管向量库的近似最近邻查询会泄露敏感查询向量，现有单服务器Pacmann因每个PIR查询仅取一个顶点而通信开销巨大。Amora将SimplePIR用于分区图索引，以VecPIR整分区取距离、NbrPIR按子组取邻居的双PIR布局把成本从每顶点转为每分区，并加入批PIR、质心剪枝和TopCand探索。在五个数据集上，其在线通信较Pacmann降93%至99%且精度更高。该工作为隐私ANNS提供了通信高效的高精度实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Approximate nearest neighbors search (ANNS) over cloud-hosted vector databases raises a critical privacy concern: the query vector, which often encodes sensitive user intent, is exposed to the server. Private ANNS (PANNS) allows a client to retrieve nearest neighbors without revealing its query. The state-of-the-art single-server scheme, Pacmann (ICLR'25), achieves high accuracy via graph-based search with private information retrieval (PIR), but incurs substantial communication overhead because each PIR query retrieves only a single vertex. We present Amora, a communication-efficient PANNS system that applies SimplePIR to a partitioned graph index so that one PIR query is amortized over many vertices. To retrieve as much of the distance and neighbor information the search needs under a limited communication budget, Amora adopts a dual-PIR split layout with two heterogeneous PIR matrices that stay balanced in dimension: VecPIR retrieves inner products for an entire partition of vertices as their distance at once, while NbrPIR retrieves necessary neighbor lists at subgroup granularity for graph traversal. This layout shifts the cost model of PIR query from per-vertex to per-partition, which significantly reduces the communication overhead. To further improve efficiency by reducing the number of scans and query rounds in the PIR database, Amora introduces batch PIR to pack multiple queries into one matrix multiplication, centroid-based pruning to filter unpromising partitions, and TopCand exploration that seeds jump-style graph navigation with the closest vertices from each retrieved partition. We evaluate Amora on five datasets spanning 96 to 1024 dimensions and up to 10 million vectors. Compared to Pacmann, Amora reduces online communication by 93--99% while achieving higher search accuracy.

papers.title_en: Poisoning the Neighborhood: A Topology-Aware Topic-Level Attack on Large-Scale HNSW-based RAG Systems
papers.authors: Yufei Chen, Yao Wang, Haibin Zhang
papers.evidence: 大规模RAG中的HNSW图近似最近邻索引
papers.tldr: 现有RAG投毒攻击多假设精确检索与全局排序，在HNSW等近似最近邻索引的大规模系统中会因搜索预算、图可达性和局部良性文档竞争而失效。本文提出面向HNSW-RAG的拓扑感知主题级投毒攻击，以Hub-Satellite结构布置毒文档，并结合实体-主张促进生成攻击。在200万篇Wikipedia文档上，检索成功率超过72%，攻击成功率达31.29%，显著优于基线。结构分析揭示Hub-Satellite拓扑在HNSW中形成，现有防御难以缓解，暴露图结构风险。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mitigates hallucinations and knowledge staleness in large language models using external knowledge. However, ingestion from public and third-party sources exposes RAG systems to poisoning attacks. Existing attacks are designed and evaluated under exact retrieval, where poisoned documents participate in global ranking. Deployment-scale systems instead rely on approximate nearest-neighbor (ANN) indexes such as hierarchical navigable small world (HNSW), where limited search budgets, graph-search reachability, and local benign-document competition invalidate this assumption and degrade existing attacks. We present a topology-aware topic-level poisoning attack against large-scale HNSW-RAG that generalizes to unseen topic queries. We organize poisoned documents into a Hub-Satellite structure: Satellites provide competitive entry points across semantic regions, while Hubs strengthen local cohesion and facilitate cascading retrieval. For generation, we propose an entity-claim promotion attack combining evidence anchoring and entity-claim coupling to promote the target entity via a target claim across different query regions. On 2M-document Wikipedia, our attack maintains over 72% retrieval success and reaches 31.29% attack success, substantially outperforming baselines; domain-specific experiments further support its effectiveness. Structural analyses show that the Hub-Satellite topology forms in HNSW, indicating that graph structure contributes to improved poisoned-document retrieval. Existing poisoning defenses cannot mitigate the attack, exposing graph-structural risks in HNSW-RAG systems.

papers.title_en: RL-Guided Temporal Localization for Dual-Channel Retrieval in Long-Horizon Agent Memory
papers.authors: Dabin Sheng, Zhe Wu, Jinming Zhao, Junliang Xing, Yuanchun Shi
papers.evidence: 面向长程智能体记忆的时间感知检索
papers.tldr: 长时程智能体记忆中，语义相似但时间错配的候选会挤占目标证据，现有方法又未在检索阶段施加时间约束。TIDER 用时序区间驱动的双通道检索框架，通过强化学习训练轻量定位器推断证据时间窗，再与语义通道融合并按时间邻近性重排。在 LifeBench 和 LoCoMo 上分别达到 61.52% 和 78.96%，较基线提升 8.82% 和 3.66%。这表明检索阶段的时间定位能有效缓解语义相似噪声，提升长时记忆证据命中率。
papers.abstract_en: Time-aware retrieval is crucial for long-horizon LLM agents to effectively leverage ever-growing long-term memory. Existing methods focus on lexical or semantic similarity, leading to target memories being crowded out by temporally mismatched yet semantically similar candidates. Even time-aware approaches inject temporal cues only during memory organization or answer generation, overlooking temporal constraints at the retrieval stage, where candidate selection occurs - the root cause of the displacement. Inspired by the temporal contiguity effect in human episodic memory, we propose TIDER (Temporal Interval-driven Dual-channel Evidence Retrieval), a time-aware agentic retrieval framework. Central to TIDER is a reinforcement learning (RL)-trained temporal interval locator that infers the temporal windows in which the evidence lies. RL optimizes window localization as a discrete, non-differentiable retrieval decision, using composite rewards to convert sparse answer supervision into fine-grained retrieval feedback. These temporal windows first define the temporal retrieval channel; the retrieved candidates are then merged with results from the semantic channel and reranked by proximity to the windows. This temporal grounding enables TIDER to retrieve temporally aligned evidence that would otherwise be drowned out by the volume of semantically similar yet temporally mismatched memories. With a lightweight 1.7B locator, TIDER achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on both long-horizon memory benchmarks - 61.52% on LifeBench (+8.82%) and 78.96% on LoCoMo (+3.66%) - which indicates that temporal cues are crucial for pinpointing target evidence amid a vast pool of semantically similar historical events in long-term daily-life memory.

papers.title_en: MemCode: Discrete Semantic Representations for Long-Term Agent Memory
papers.authors: Xin Li, Liang Hu, Duoqian Miao, Ming Peng, Qi Zhang
papers.evidence: 基于码本量化与离散联想检索的长期智能体记忆
papers.tldr: 长时记忆是LLM智能体跨会话的核心瓶颈，现有“先写后取”范式依赖连续嵌入近邻检索，记忆单元不稳定且易漏语义相关证据。MemCode将对话改写为自包含原子记忆单元，经同构语义量化映射到可学习码本，并以码本共现拓扑补充向量检索。它在LongMemEval-S和LoCoMo上取得最佳总体准确率，单段对话记忆构建约40~130秒，显著快于LightMem、A-MEM和MemoryOS。该工作以离散关联检索提升长期记忆的稳定性与效率。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory remains a fundamental bottleneck for large language model (LLM) agents across sessions. Existing systems typically adopt a write-then-retrieve paradigm, storing context-dependent dialogue fragments and retrieving them via nearest-neighbor search in a continuous embedding space. This design yields unstable access units and systematically misses logically related but lexically distant evidence. We propose MemCode, a long-term agent memory framework that couples retrieval-oriented writing with discrete associative retrieval. MemCode rewrites dialogue into self-contained atomic memory units (AMUs), maps AMUs into a learnable codebook with isomorphic semantic quantization (ISQ), and uses codebook co-occurrence topology as a retrieval path complementary to vector search. For long-term memory stores, MemCode separates online atomic writes from asynchronous offline consolidation. On LongMemEval-S and LoCoMo with GPT-4o-mini and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 backbones, MemCode achieves the best overall accuracy while keeping per-dialogue memory construction within roughly 40~130 seconds, making it 3~21 times faster than LightMem and over an order of magnitude faster than A-MEM and MemoryOS.

papers.title_en: MemComposer: Learning to Assemble Memories for LLM Agents via Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Yixuan Xie, Xueqiang Xu, Xinyi Fan, Xinxi Lyu, Tao Feng, Xing Fan, Chenlei Guo, Jie Hao, Shaowen Wang, Jiashuo Sun, Jiawei Han
papers.evidence: 为LLM智能体学习组装检索到的记忆
papers.tldr: LLM智能体可复用记忆而无需更新参数，但仅靠语义相似度无法保证记忆有用，关键在如何选择与呈现。MemComposer联合审视当前查询与候选记忆，决定纳入哪些经验、选择多少及如何排序。它用基于GRPO的ExPO，以完整智能体交互和任务成功反馈优化记忆组装策略。在τ²-bench三个领域、两个冻结执行器上均优于最强基线，并降低平均记忆token用量16.9%与4.9%，且可迁移到未见领域、执行器和记忆库。
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to reuse past experiences without updating their parameters. However, semantic similarity alone does not guarantee memory usefulness: downstream performance depends on how memories are selected and presented to the agent. We propose MemComposer, a memory composer that jointly examines the current query and retrieved candidates to decide which experiences to include, how many to select, and how to order them. We train the composer using Experience Policy Optimization (ExPO), a GRPO-based framework that evaluates assembled memory contexts through complete agent interactions and uses task-success feedback to optimize the assembly policy. Across three $τ^2$-bench domains with two frozen executors, MemComposer outperforms the strongest baseline for each executor while reducing average memory-token usage by 16.9% and 4.9%, respectively. The learned policy also transfers to unseen domains, executors, and memory banks, and benefits from memories generated by stronger models without further training. These results demonstrate the value of learning query-specific memory assembly using downstream task feedback.

papers.title_en: CertEx: Exact Visual Retrieval at Scale by Certified Exclusion
papers.authors: Dongfang Zhao
papers.evidence: 面向高维嵌入的GPU大规模精确最近邻检索
papers.tldr: 精确kNN是视觉检索、近重复检测与LLM智能体记忆的基础，但穷举全精度计算昂贵，近似索引又无法保证召回。CertEx提出“认证排除”：用半精度下界投影和舍入证书在同一次张量核点积中保守判定可排除向量，仅对少数候选计算精确距离。作者证明其每个查询均返回精确kNN，在16个至多1亿向量的数据集上取得相对cuVS 7.1–18.0倍吞吐，并在必须精确时优于量化与图索引。
papers.abstract_en: Exact $k$-nearest-neighbor (kNN) search over image descriptors and embeddings underlies visual retrieval, near-duplicate detection, the evaluation of learned representations, and increasingly the memory of LLM agents. However, exhaustive search computes every distance at full precision, whereas approximate indexes return recall below one. We observe that exact search only needs a proof that each excluded vector cannot be a neighbor. Because such a proof only has to be conservative, it can be checked in low precision, much as the retina examines the whole scene at low resolution. We call this principle certified exclusion and realize it in an exact kNN method for GPUs, which we call \certex. Specifically, \certex\ stores a lower-bounding projection of each vector in half precision and folds a rounding certificate into the same tensor-core dot product, so that only the few vectors that the test keeps need exact distances. We prove that \certex\ returns the exact kNN of every query. On sixteen datasets with up to 100M vectors, \certex\ is exact for every query at 7.1$\times$ to 18.0$\times$ the throughput of the fastest cuVS search on one H100 and outperforms quantized and graph indexes whenever every query must be exact.

papers.title_en: Beyond Downstream QA: Rethinking How We Evaluate Agent Memory
papers.authors: Sebastian-Antonio Toma, Jean de Kernier, Mike Ply, Oliviu Matei
papers.evidence: 评估智能体记忆正确性的基准
papers.tldr: 现有智能体记忆评测多用下游问答准确率作为代理，混淆了记忆正确性与检索生成质量，既会漏报也会误判。作者提出FEB-30基准，用范式反转从已知事实轨迹生成文档，构建30条事实演化轨迹，覆盖6类诊断维度和3级难度。实验显示内在与外在评测平均相差16个百分点，44%轨迹超过显著差异阈值，且系统正确分类记忆操作仅20%。该工作揭示下游QA评测盲区，并开源基准、生成流程与评分框架。
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory benchmarks evaluate whether an agent's responses reflect correct knowledge, measuring downstream question-answering accuracy as a proxy for memory quality. We show this evaluation paradigm is incomplete: it conflates memory correctness with retrieval and generation quality, producing both false positives where correct responses mask broken memory and false negatives where incorrect responses blame correct memory for retrieval failures. We introduce FEB-30, a benchmark of 30 fact-evolution trajectories spanning 6 diagnostic categories and 3 difficulty levels, constructed via paradigm inversion: documents are generated from known fact trajectories, yielding deterministic ground truth without human annotation. Each trajectory defines how a fact should evolve across multi-author artifacts (documents, emails, conversations), enabling direct inspection of the memory store after each ingestion step. Applying FEB-30 to a representative memory system, we demonstrate that intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation diverge by an average of 16 percentage points, with 44% of trajectories exceeding meaningful divergence thresholds. Diagnostic decomposition reveals that the system correctly classifies memory operations (create, update, reinforce, supersede) only 20% of the time, a failure entirely invisible to extrinsic evaluation, and that failure modes differ systematically by category and difficulty. We release the benchmark, document generation pipeline, and scoring framework to support reproducible evaluation of agent memory systems.

papers.title_en: From Memory Hits to Answerable Evidence: Query-Conditioned Memory Compilation for Long-Term Agent Memory
papers.authors: Shangze Li, Yanyu Yao, Derong Xu, Zhi Zheng, Tong Xu
papers.evidence: 长期智能体记忆与查询条件化证据编译
papers.tldr: 长期对话记忆需要跨轮次、跨会话找回与答案相关的证据，现有结构化记忆与自适应检索常把检索或扩展单元直接交给阅读器，导致上下文冗余或不完整。MemCompile 将记忆寻址与证据呈现解耦，用 Address Plane 定位支持并用 Evidence Plane 在预算内编译答案就绪证据。它在 LoCoMo 上达到 80.52% Judge Accuracy，并将质量—成本帕累托前沿推向更高质量区间。该工作表明查询条件化的证据编译能提升长期对话记忆的答案可证成性。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term agent memory requires recovering answer-relevant evidence dispersed across turns and sessions. Existing systems increasingly use structured memories and adaptive retrieval, yet often pass retrieved or expanded units directly to the reader, coupling memory addressing with evidence presentation and leaving the final context redundant or incomplete. To address this gap, we propose MemCompile, a query-conditioned evidence compilation framework for long-term conversational memory. Given a query, the Address Plane locates relevant support through compact source-linked descriptors and capacity-aware Cells, while a normalization boundary resolves heterogeneous retrieval hits to stable SourcePacket identities. Its Evidence Plane then allocates a bounded evidence budget across complementary packets, admits limited additional support, and renders the retained claims associated with each selected packet into an answer-ready context. MemCompile achieves 80.52% Judge Accuracy on LoCoMo and extends the empirical quality-cost Pareto frontier to a higher-quality regime. Its strong performance on LongMemEval-S further suggests that the benefits of query-conditioned compilation generalize across long-term conversational-memory benchmarks.

papers.title_en: Retrieving Complementary Evidence for Multi-Hop RAG with Semantic Gain Graphs
papers.authors: Zeliang Li, Xiaofen Xing, Kailing Guo, Xiangmin Xu
papers.evidence: 基于语义增益图的多跳检索增强生成与互补证据检索
papers.tldr: 多跳RAG需检索组合后互补的证据，但查询相关性与图连通性不能直接衡量文档的增量信息。SG²RAG离线用大模型评估语义相似邻域内块间相关且非冗余的信息，聚合成对称边权构建可复用语义增益图；在线从查询相关种子出发，用受控个性化PageRank排序初始集外的互补证据。在MuSiQue、2Wiki、HotpotQA上，其平均EM、F1、Recall@10优于所评估单次检索方法，语义增益较相似度加权平均F1和Recall@10分别提升4.08和4.31点。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires finding documents whose evidence is useful in combination. Query relevance and graph connectivity help locate related content, but neither directly measures the additional information one document contributes given another. We introduce SG$^2$RAG, a framework that represents this complementarity through semantic gain. Offline, a large language model assesses the relevant and nonredundant information contributed by one chunk given another within neighborhoods proposed by semantic similarity. These ordered assessments are aggregated into symmetric edge weights to construct a reusable Semantic Gain Graph. Online, controlled Personalized PageRank starts from query-relevant seeds and ranks complementary evidence beyond the initial retrieval set. Experiments on MuSiQue, 2Wiki, and HotpotQA with two language model backbones show that SG$^2$RAG achieves the best average EM, F1, and Recall@10 among the evaluated single-retrieval methods. Under identical candidate support and propagation, semantic gain improves average F1 and Recall@10 over similarity weighting by 4.08 and 4.31 points. Analyses of supporting documents and improvements in three iterative retrieval frameworks further support its effectiveness as a reusable retrieval component.

papers.title_en: Seeing, Maintaining, and Learning: The Evolution of Multimodal Agent Memory
papers.authors: Minghao Guo, Qingyue Jiao, Xiujin Liu, Jianhong Pang, Ruimeng Yang, Naihao Xu, Liwei Che, Haochen Xue, Ziqi Wang, Xinying Cai, Jiaxuan Luo, Jiaxin Deng, Xuesong Ye, Jintao Qu, Wenyao Gao, Jingwen Gu, Chenyang Zhao, Shichun Liu, Guibin Zhang, Zefang Liu, Siyin Wang, Wujiang Xu, Danrui Li, Zeru Shi, Woongyeong Yeo, Shuang Liu, Wei-Chieh Huang, Weizhi Zhang, Tianyu Yang, Kangsan Kim, Yebowen Hu, Bowen Wen, Bowen Jiang, Haohao Su, Ming Yin, Sheldon Yu, Mian Zhang, Yuyan Chen, Hanrong Zhang, Kai Mei, Zihao Zhang, Mingyu Jin, Xi Zhu, Hengyi Wang, Tianxin Wei, Linyong Nan, Zhenwen Liang, Zhendong Chu, Ziqi Huang, Yongye Su, Sixun Dong, Shujian Liu, Kaiqu Liang, Jiaojiao Han, Zhaoye Fei, Kun Wang, Shihan Dou, Zhichun Guo, Xingjian Diao, Zeqi Gu, Heng Wang, Tao Feng, Cheng Qian, Hamid Palangi, Silei Xu, Xi Yun, Yi Zhu, Shilong Liu, Qingsong Wen, Sung Ju Hwang, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang, Yiyu Shi, Dimitris N. Metaxas, Jiaxuan You, Julian McAuley, Mengdi Wang, Jiawei Han, Philip S. Yu, Ziyi Ye
papers.evidence: 长期多模态智能体的记忆机制
papers.tldr: 多模态智能体正走向长时程与终身学习，但如何在复杂异构数据中持续获取并保持信息仍是难题，跨会话连续性与记忆策略自适应尤为关键。本文提出双轴分析框架：轴一刻画多模态记忆的形成与表示，轴二将记忆管理分为静态复用、动态更新与自演化三层。作者据此归纳反复出现的设计模式，并提炼保真与抽象平衡、时序有效性与来源追溯、记忆使用可恢复证据支撑、记忆策略随经验演化等原则。该工作为多模态智能体记忆机制提供了统一的分析视角与未来研究方向。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal models and agents have emerged to enable AI systems to learn from and interact with the real world more like humans by integrating information across multiple modalities. However, enabling multimodal agents to continually acquire useful information from complex, heterogeneous multimodal data remains a significant challenge as they move toward long-horizon tasks and lifelong settings. Addressing this challenge requires effective memory mechanisms that can maintain continuity across sessions, adapt to changing users and environments, and refine memory-management policies through accumulated experience. We introduce a two-axis analytical framework for multimodal agent memory structured around two key questions: how multimodal information is formed and represented (Axis I, Formation and Representation), and how its management adapts with accumulated experience (Axis II, Memory Management). Axis I, Formation and Representation, characterizes what information is retained and how it is encoded (e.g., modality-specific embeddings, textual and structured records, latent and parametric representations) to support subsequent reasoning and action. Axis II, Memory Management, distinguishes three tiers: T1 Static Memory reuses fixed memory; T2 Dynamic Memory updates memory through a stable policy; and T3 Self-Evolving Memory updates memory through an evolving policy. Based on this framework, we synthesize recurring design patterns and derive principles for balancing source fidelity with abstraction, maintaining temporal validity and provenance, grounding memory use in recoverable evidence, and evolving memory policies over time. Furthermore, we discuss the challenges and potential future directions for the memory mechanism of multimodal agents.

papers.title_en: RCER: Reconstructing Cross-Evidence Relations for Iterative Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Linyao Zheng, Xuhang Shi, Zhifang Mao, Xiuquan Hou, Sai Zhou
papers.evidence: 面向复杂知识密集型问答的迭代检索增强生成
papers.tldr: 迭代RAG在复杂多跳问答中需整合多段证据，但新信息出现时难以重构跨段落实体对应与推理依赖。RCER从累积源段落重建跨证据关系，以轮间关系证据获取驱动问题分解与检索，并通过推理上下文重构和组合推理推导答案。在三个多跳QA基准上平均提升2.83 EM和3.06 F1，并在叙事与隐式推理任务上表现更优。该工作增强了迭代检索中跨证据关系建模与组合推理能力。
papers.abstract_en: Iterative retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) accumulates knowledge from retrieved evidence to answer complex questions, but existing methods struggle to reconstruct entity correspondences and inferential dependencies across retrieved passages as new information emerges. We propose RCER, an iterative RAG method that reconstructs these cross-evidence relations directly from accumulated source passages. Inter-round relational evidence acquisition identifies entity correspondences and relational dependencies to drive dynamic problem decomposition and iterative retrieval. Reasoning context reconstruction independently constructs a coherent reasoning context through joint selection of complementary passages and derivation of cross-evidence inferences. Cross-evidence compositional reasoning leverages these inferences to establish entity correspondences and compose relations across selected passages for answer derivation. Experiments show that RCER outperforms the best baselines by 2.83 EM and 3.06 F1 points on average across three multi-hop QA benchmarks and achieves superior performance on narrative and implicit reasoning tasks.

papers.title_en: Beyond Retrieval: Evidence Access and Event Aggregation in Agent Memory
papers.authors: Zerui Yang, Quan Xue, Chaorui Zhang, Xueyan Niu, Xuanyu Zheng, Xiyuan Wang, Haolin Ruan, Guangcheng Song, Weixi Zhang, Wei Han, Bo Bai
papers.evidence: 结合检索与事件聚合的智能体记忆系统
papers.tldr: 智能体历史问答常需跨事件聚合，仅靠检索难以完成。Trajectory Memory保留原始轨迹并在提问时构建可溯源阅读视图，TallyMem再引入可复用事件账本、模型生成事件规范与确定性执行。在99个MINTEval仓库的776题上，Qwen3-32B精确匹配从35.2%升至49.0%，较TM提高13.8点；独立解析事件的探针实验提高11.0点。结果表明，可执行聚合能补足检索式记忆，但收益受任务与事件规范影响。
papers.abstract_en: Questions about an agent's history often require aggregating events, which retrieval alone does not resolve. We combine source-preserving evidence access with executable aggregation. Trajectory Memory (TM) retains the original trajectory and constructs a source-addressable reading view at question time. TallyMem augments it with a reusable event ledger, model-generated event specifications and deterministic execution. With a commit-specific adaptation on 776 questions from 99 held-out MINTEval repositories, TallyMem raises Qwen3-32B exact match from 35.2% to 49.0%, a 13.8-point gain over TM; gains span 12.8-13.9 points across three readers. A controlled probe with event sets parsed independently from raw logs shows an 11.0-point gain, from 82.8% to 93.8%, without routing. On full AMA-Bench, the routed system yields a smaller 1.3-point gain, from 69.8% to 71.1%. These results support executable aggregation on tasks that require combining events, with benefits dependent on the task and event specification, the largest residual system-error category in our diagnostic analysis.

papers.title_en: CARA: Causally Guided Retrieval Agent for Question Answering
papers.authors: Weicheng Liu, Xiangcheng Wu, Depeng Xu, Haopeng Zhang, Xi Niu
papers.evidence: 面向检索增强问答的因果引导检索智能体
papers.tldr: 在文本丰富的知识图谱上做检索增强生成时，关键是要找到真正支撑回答的证据，而不仅是文本相似的内容。现有智能检索器虽能平衡全局搜索与多跳探索，却主要依赖文本相似度来引导检索。CARA 是一种免训练的因果引导检索智能体，用“加入证据是否提升可答性”和“移除证据是否削弱可答性”两个因果标准评估证据，并结合路径一致性引导图探索、用倒数排名融合聚合多智能体证据。在三个 STaRK 数据集上，CARA 持续优于现有检索器，同时提升答案质量与忠实度，且检查的图节点和检索操作更少。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation over text-rich knowledge graphs requires identifying evidence that contributes to answering a question, rather than merely matching its textual content. Existing agentic retrievers adaptively balance global search and multi-hop exploration but primarily rely on textual similarity to guide retrieval. We propose CARA, a training-free, CAusally guided Retrieval Agent that explicitly evaluates the causal relevance of retrieved evidence through two complementary criteria: consequentiality, measuring whether adding evidence improves answerability, and essentiality, assessing whether removing evidence weakens answerability. CARA integrates these assessments with path consistency to guide graph exploration and employs reciprocal rank fusion to aggregate evidence from multiple agents. We evaluate CARA on three STaRK datasets and augment STaRK with ground-truth answers to enable downstream question answering evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that CARA consistently outperforms existing retrievers. CARA also improves answer quality and faithfulness while examining fewer graph nodes and requiring fewer retrieval operations. These findings demonstrate that causal relevance assessment enables more focused and effective agentic graph retrieval, improving both retrieval performance and downstream question answering.

papers.title_en: Private Retrieval Augmented Generation via Random Projection
papers.authors: Dixi Yao, Tahseen Rabbani, Tian Li
papers.evidence: 基于随机投影的隐私保护检索增强生成
papers.tldr: RAG 能增强大模型的外部知识利用，但检索库可能泄露敏感信息。本文提出对数据存储与查询嵌入施加同一随机投影，在理论上保持语义相似度的同时显著缓解数据抽取攻击。多架构多数据集实验中，该轻量方法在检索与生成性能上优于依赖形式化差分隐私的基线，并在强攻击下取得可比的经验隐私。结果表明随机投影可作为隐私保护 RAG 的实用竞争基线。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by querying external structured knowledge. However, it can also introduce privacy risks by leaking sensitive information from the retrieval datastore. We propose a simple method to preserve datastore privacy in RAG systems via random projection. By applying the same projection to both datastore embeddings and query embeddings, our method provably preserves semantic similarity between queries and retrieved items while substantially mitigating data extraction attacks. Across multiple RAG architectures and datasets, we show that this lightweight approach achieves superior retrieval and generation performance compared to prior methods which leverage formal differential privacy (DP) guarantees, while exhibiting comparable empirical privacy under strong attack models. Our results for the first time suggest that random projection can serve as a competitive and practical baseline for privacy-preserving RAG systems.

papers.title_en: GLOBE: Evolving Structured Agentic Memory for E-commerce Product Optimization in Generative Search
papers.authors: Hyunseo Kim, Suil Choe, Sukkyoung So, Daeyeon Yi
papers.evidence: 面向语言智能体的结构化智能体记忆
papers.tldr: 生成式搜索的商品优化需要智能体跨品类积累有效改写策略，但现有方法把结构化列表当自由文本，策略隐含在提示或轨迹中难以复用。GLOBE把优化知识组织为可演化的字段级行为手册，由Editor应用行为、Reflector将排名反馈转为更新，并用Moderator与Curator审核提交、停用有害行为。实验显示结构化行为优于整体提示优化，反馈演化与审核进一步提升效果并降低风险，学到的行为还能迁移到未见品类。
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing product listings for generative search requires language agents not only to rewrite effectively but also to continually self-improve by retaining successful strategies across diverse categories. However, existing approaches often treat structured listings as free-form text, leaving effective strategies implicit in prompts, search trajectories, or rewritten outputs rather than accumulating them as a reusable agentic memory. To address this limitation, we introduce GLOBE, an agentic framework that drives continual self-improvement by storing optimization knowledge in an evolving handbook of explicit, field-scoped behaviors. In each episode, an Editor applies relevant behaviors and receives rank-based feedback, which a Reflector converts into behavior updates. Crucially for dependable execution in real-world settings, a Moderator removes redundant proposals, a Curator commits accepted changes, and consistently harmful behaviors are deactivated. This cycle transforms episodic feedback into a persistent, field-scoped optimization memory. Experiments show that structured behaviors outperform monolithic prompt optimization, while feedback-driven evolution and moderation further improve effectiveness and reduce downside risk. The learned behaviors also remain effective on unseen product categories, suggesting that agentic memory evolution supports interpretable and transferable product optimization.

papers.title_en: Which Code Changes Need Re-embedding? CIPBench and the Limits of Multi-Signal Index Maintenance
papers.authors: Nannan Zhao, Jiameng Zhang, Taoyu Zhong, Hao Wang, Bo Wang
papers.evidence: 为仓库级RAG维护向量索引
papers.tldr: 仓库级RAG需让向量索引与持续演进的代码同步，但缺少判断哪些变更代码单元需重新嵌入的原则性依据。论文跨10个Python/Go/JS开源仓库刻画语法实质、嵌入位移与检索影响的传播，并提出CIPBench在嵌入前信息边界下评测维护策略。结果显示仅用变更历史的排序器可显著降低检索损害，但加入另外三类信号后决策统计上不变；真正有效的是过滤文本未变单元，在回退多的项目可省近半嵌入成本。
papers.abstract_en: Repository-level retrieval-augmented generation systems must keep vector indexes synchronized with continuously evolving code, yet there is no principled basis for deciding which changed code units actually need new embeddings. We ask whether the retrieval impact of a code change can be anticipated before that embedding is computed.   Across 10 open-source repositories in Python, Go, and JavaScript, we characterize how a change propagates from syntactic substantiality through embedding displacement to retrieval impact. The links are informative but not deterministic: syntactic class separates displacement sharply, yet impact depends on a unit's retrieval exposure as much as on how far its representation moves, and recurring counterexamples bound what any single signal can decide. We formalize the decision as CIPBench, a benchmark that scores maintenance policies under a strict pre-embedding information boundary.   Prediction works, and one signal exhausts it. A ranker using only a unit's change history substantially reduces retrieval harm relative to random and recency-based scheduling. Combining it with three further signals--individually discriminative and largely unassociated with one another--leaves the decision statistically unchanged across every budget we evaluate, for reasons we trace to the structure of the score rather than to its tuning. What pays off is not ranking but filtering: units whose text is unchanged from the indexed state can be skipped with no risk and, in the most reversion-heavy project, at nearly half the embedding cost. Signal-level informativeness is therefore not evidence of decision-level value, and separating the two requires evaluating the decision a signal produces rather than its association with the outcome.
